about: Electrochemical workstations and accessories: connect PORT=ID, technique (cv, lsv, ca, cp, steps, qcm, secm-line, secm-approach), start (job), stop, data, rotate (RRDE rotator), move (SECM probe), zero (QCM baseline), status. Ranges and units come from each member's contract.

secondary_not_mapped.ika_electrasyn2: preparative electrolysis with a CV mode; its primary class (reactor) owns the instrument and can reuse these handlers
secondary_not_mapped.metrohm_914: pH / conductivity probes are measuring cells, not a potentiostat; property_meter owns it
secondary_not_mapped.pccell_ed64002: electrodialysis stack (a separation process); its primary class (extraction) owns it

membership.notes: power and open / close of lids and the rotator enclosure come from the shared layer.

technique: the Gamry plays the waveform as discrete points: cv / lsv sweep in --step increments at --rate (interval = step / rate); at most 10000 points
measured current and potential channels of this twin are null (it records the commanded series only); the lab's template cell is for electrochem.template_cv

acquisition.start:NOT_READY.message: {inst} cannot start: power, a technique, the solution and a closed lid are needed.

acquisition.start:METHOD_PROCESS_MISMATC.message: the technique does not fit the cell of {inst}: qcm (frequency only) is for a film that adsorbs without current, while a plating bath needs a potential or current technique.
acquisition.start:METHOD_PROCESS_MISMATC.fix: choose ca, cp or steps for a plating bath (`chemlab run {inst} technique cp --current 10uA --time 2s`).

unsupported.connect: the electrodes are fixed in the EQCM cell (no connection slots)

technique: techniques: ca (potential step), cp (current step), steps (a staircase of potentials or currents), qcm (frequency only)
the reference electrode label keeps the last one, else the documented one; give --reference TEXT to change it
current sign as in this twin (and the CHI software default): a positive current is cathodic (reduces, plates the film); a negative potential vs the bath's E0 plates too
zero: sets the frequency baseline; frequency shifts and the inferred mass count from it (Sauerbrey)

technique: secm-line scans the probe along the --path at constant height; secm-approach records an approach curve along the path
path points are X,Y,Z separated by ';' (bare numbers in mm; µm is usual: -40um,-40um,5um)
move: moves the probe and waits until the positioner is at rest

unsupported.connect: the ring-disk electrode is mounted on the rotator shaft (no connection slots)
unsupported.technique: a rotator only: the disk and ring potentials are set on the external bipotentiostat

alternatives.technique: rotate the electrode (`chemlab run INST rotate 1600rpm`) and record (`chemlab run INST start --time 30s`); the lab sets the potentials.

start: start --time T [--interval DT] records the disk and ring currents for T (at most 600 s)
disk and ring currents follow IUPAC: a reducing (cathodic) disk current is negative
rotate: 100 to 8000 rpm when idle, at most 3000 rpm while recording; `rotate off` stops the motor
